description: Twenty-three manga/manhwa sources with native reader support for Yomira 0.2.27 and newer.

sourcePacks.description: Twenty-three manga/manhwa sources with native reader support for Yomira 0.2.27 and newer.
releaseNotes: Requires Yomira iOS 0.2.27 (20) or newer for the new built-in reader profiles.
Adds LikeManga, ManhwaToon, Chikari, ToonVerse, XComic (.me/.net), Swarm and Kagane via its official-listed kagane.si mirror.

Repairs KuraManga search pagination using its current page-based public API. Atsumaru CDN pages and provider labels are repaired in the accompanying Rust core; providers remain selectable within one Source.
Swarm exposes the latest 10,000 upstream uploads across languages; older chapter history may be unavailable. Toonkotsu and Project Suki remain held for browser-session support.
Preserves source identities and prior immutable releases. Source Pack imports do not automatically add all definitions to My Sources. Physical-device acceptance remains separate.
